nodes.label: Laya System-1 Decision Model (ONNX Runtime)
nodes.rationale: Runs in-process on CPU via ONNX Runtime to make calibrated choice/score/noul judgment calls for meal planning without requiring a GPU.

nodes.label: Core Backend + CLI Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Breaks the deterministic core backend, SQLite WAL state layer, FastAPI server, thin httpx CLI, and Docker Compose setup into 12 TDD tasks.

nodes.label: Open-Fresh Design Specification
nodes.rationale: Inverts Grocy's rigid workflow by providing live-correlated views over a shared kitchen state without locking users into a sequential wizard.

nodes.label: Three-Tier Layered Pricing Model
nodes.rationale: Open Prices has thin US store coverage, so pricing resolves per kitchen in order: (1) own price library, (2) Open Prices nearest match, (3) category estimate.

nodes.label: Household Servings Scaling, Coarse Units, and Staple Flags
nodes.norm_label: household servings scaling, coarse units, and staple flags
nodes.rationale: Quantities scale to household size or per-meal override; only identical units merge to avoid brittle dimensional conversions; staples carry a never-list flag.

nodes.label: Source-Tagged Inventory Management & Cooking Consumption
nodes.rationale: Inventory is a first-class surface with an audit log tagged by source (shopping, cooking, manual, receipt); no expiry tracking in v1 to avoid manual complexity, and cooked check-off deducts ingredients without restoring on plan removal.

nodes.label: Local Recipe & Receipt Ingest Pipeline (Gemma 3n E2B/E4B)
nodes.norm_label: local recipe & receipt ingest pipeline (gemma 3n e2b/e4b)
nodes.rationale: Runs outside the app container behind an OpenAI-compatible endpoint using schema.org/Recipe first and local small LLM fallback, flagging uncertain fields for review rather than failing loudly.

nodes.label: Kitchen Domain Model (Pantry, Fridge, Freezer, Range, Cookbook)
nodes.norm_label: kitchen domain model (pantry, fridge, freezer, range, cookbook)
nodes.rationale: Models a household kitchen with physical storage locations and a cookbook correlated with calendar, grocery list, and budget.

nodes.label: Open-Fresh Self-Hosted Meal Prep Concept
nodes.rationale: Self-hosted open-source alternative to HelloFresh where users bring their own recipes/videos and get correlated meal plans, grocery lists, and budgets.

nodes.label: Single-Household Kitchen Metaphor
nodes.rationale: One instance per household, not a sequential wizard and not multi-tenant; heavy AI/ingest services run outside the core container to keep the core small and private.

nodes.label: Docker Compose openfresh Service
nodes.rationale: Persists SQLite database in ./data:/data with OPENFRESH_DB=/data/openfresh.db and polls GET /settings for container healthcheck.
